sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Cuba.
Cuba is a colorful, sunny and musical island
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean.
It is close to the United States, Mexico, Haiti, and Jamaica.
Cuba has beaches, mountains, and old towns.
What is the capital city of Cuba?
Havana is a big city with old buildings,
It is full of life and color.
Other cities in Cuba include Santiago de Cuba,
How many people live in Cuba?
About 11 million people live in Cuba.
Most people live in cities and towns near the coast.
Cuban people are known for being friendly,
What language do people speak in Cuba?
Many people also speak a little English,
Cuban Spanish is spoken with a unique accent and rhythm.
What is the weather like in Cuba?
It is hot and humid most of the year.
The dry season from November to April.
The rainy season from May to October.
There is a risk of hurricanes from August to October.
Cuba has white sand beaches and blue water,
It is a beautiful country with rich culture and nature.
Crocodiles and fish, cows, chickens, and goats on farms.
The bee hummingbird, the smallest bird in the world,
What do people eat in Cuba?
Cuban food is simple, flavorful, and made with love.
People eat rice, beans, and plantains,
a roscon polo, chicken with rice,
Cuban sandwich, ham, cheese, and pickles,
What do people drink in Cuba?
often in cocktails like mojito or daikiri.
Cuban coffee is small but very strong.
What is life like in Cuba?
Life in Cuba is social, creative,
People often meet in the street,
What are some holidays and traditions in Cuba?
May Day May 1st with big parades,
carnival with music, costumes, and dance,
New Year's Eve with fireworks and parties.
sun, and rumba are played at festivals.
Cuba has classic American cars from the 1950s.
Baseball is the most popular sport.
Cigars from Cuba are famous around the world.
the writer lived in Cuba for many years.
The Cuban flag is red, white,
and blue with a white star.
